name: product-lifecycle-templates
description: 27 researched document-template bundles across the full product lifecycle, covering the complete Tier-1 floor of a 205-type catalog. Each bundle ships a lean template and most also a full one, a worked example on one continuous scenario, an operator guide with a self-grade rubric, a deep companion, and the research log every claim traces to. 31 CI steps enforce structure, citation integrity and honest retrieval. An MCP server serves the catalog to agents and validates filled documents against it. Status experimental: efficacy has been measured four times, three returned VOID and the fourth cleared every validity gate on 2026-09-03 over two scenarios of one bundle, which is too narrow to support a library-wide claim, and no template has yet been filled by anyone but the author.
